delivery_total.source: Kobas Daily Headline Revenue Report (All Venues) -> Script Raw Data sheet, Delivery column (Deliverect lines, all platforms incl. HungryPanda, gross incl. VAT), via the Auto Cash Up dailies
delivery_total.basis: sum of daily delivery GBP Mon-Sun; orders = Deliveroo Daily Master (Deliveroo only)

labour_split.source: Mona Lisa 'Input Tabs' actual FOH/BOH block (pipe 1).
labour_split.note: 'absent' = the site filed no actual FOH/BOH split on any trading day of the week - NOT a failed validation and NOT a zero. 'filed' = it filed something; this pipe does not reconstruct or validate the split (rows are shifted in that tab), so 'filed' is not a validated 'ok'.

efficiency_score.scale: 0–100, 100 = at target; bands: green ≥95, amber ≥80, red <80
efficiency_score.formula_ref: control_centre efficiencyScore() v3 — SPH 15% (level vs per-format target + WoW momentum); each component hard-capped at 100; Lifetime★ excluded

red_light.basis: computed from the dashboard's own KPIs (sales vs target ≤ -10%, wage > 26%, food > 25%); no external pull

negative_reviews.author: Kristina Sreckovic
negative_reviews.text: Ordering food from there 3 times now, and all 3 times I’ve been given a different order. It’s ridiculous at this point

negative_reviews.author: jessica dorsett
negative_reviews.text: Burnt food!  We got credit back for the roll on Deliveroo but being pregnant and starving I’m disappointed I won’t be able to eat my food. The quality of maki and ramen has gone down so far since they first opened.

negative_reviews.author: Jason Yu
negative_reviews.text: I ordered food it was burnt and arrived by deliveroo, just shows a complete lack of quality control for the food and it’s honestly not acceptable, I hope they really consider how they do things

reviews.source: Google Reviews workbook 1aFGfbGr... 'Raw Data' tab (gid 284143046), full-history rows deduped on reviewId, filtered by review RECEIVED date to 2026-10-26..2026-11-01 (Mon-Sun).
